Subject: Request for One-Time Exception to Return Policy – Order ODR-100123

Dear Customer Support Team,

I’m writing about order ODR-100123, specifically the Summer Dress I received. The dress was just delivered today, and I’d like to return it.

I was under the impression that the return window starts on the date of delivery, not before, so I was surprised to see that the system now shows the return window as expired. The dress is unused, in new condition, with all original tags attached and the original packaging.

Given these circumstances, I’m kindly requesting a one-time exception to your standard return policy and asking if you could issue a prepaid return label so I can send the dress back for a refund.

Please let me know if you need any photos, additional details, or confirmation of the item’s condition.

Thank you for your consideration, and I appreciate any help you can offer.

Best regards,
Lisa Park
lisa.park@peachtreechildrens.org</action>
